For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be
used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL8.2 - libdasd: Fix dasd_get_host_access_count() (BZ#1905085)

* RHEL8.1 - zcryptstats: Fix handling of partial results with many domains
(s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1912479)

* RHEL8.3 - dasdfmt: Fix bad file descriptor error when running on symlinks
(s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1917853)

* RHEL8.3 - lscpumf adjust output for raw event number
(s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1917854)
